summary: Iteration-7 testing of server-generated voice preview (ElevenLabs with OpenAI TTS fallback) + super-admin ElevenLabs key panel. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_vozlead_iter7.py — 12/12 tests pass covering (a) GET /api/voice-preview/demo.wav public, 200 audio/wav, X-Voice-Source=openai, duration ~>=6s, voice energy (RMS>0.02) present in seconds 1-8 (not just keyboard/ambience); (b) GET /api/voice-preview requires auth (401), invalid voice -> 422, empty text -> 422, custom:<other-tenant> -> 404, valid request returns audio/wav with non-silent voice; (c) GET /api/admin/elevenlabs returns {connected:false,key_last4:null} for admin, 403 for member; (d) PUT /api/admin/elevenlabs with invalidkeyinvalidkey12345 -> 400 and still disconnected; schema violation (<20 chars) -> 422; non-admin -> 403. Full backend regression now 111 passed, 1 skipped, 2 pre-existing failures (test_vozlead_iter6::test_existing_agents_migrated and test_vozlead_backend::test_recording_proxy_admin_lead — both unrelated to this iteration). Frontend Playwright verified: (1) Landing / landing-hero-demo-button clicks transition data-state idle -> playing on desktop (1920x1080) and iPhone viewport (390x844); second click stops (data-state=idle). Uses a single HTMLAudioElement (0 persistent <audio> nodes in DOM, element is in-memory via `new Audio()`), fixing the iOS silent-mode speechSynthesis issue since the browser now plays a real WAV. (2) /app/admin elevenlabs-settings-panel shows elevenlabs-status-missing; typing 'invalidkeyinvalidkey12345' + elevenlabs-save-button triggers PUT returning 400 and an error toast is shown; status remains missing. (3) /app/agentes agent-builder Voz tab audio-preview-play-button plays preview (data-state reaches 'playing'), confirming cookie-authenticated GET /api/voice-preview integration. First uncached generation ~4-10s (OpenAI TTS), cached playback instant.
critical_code_review_comments: voice_preview.py: _mix_cache is an in-process OrderedDict with max 40 entries — fine for single-worker, but if backend scales to multiple uvicorn workers each worker will have its own cache (and after PUT /api/admin/elevenlabs only the handling worker clears its cache, others still serve stale openai audio). Low priority given current single-worker supervisor config.
voice_preview.py eleven_tts: on ElevenLabs error raises HTTPException(400) with upstream message — fine, but any 5xx from ElevenLabs is surfaced as 400 to the client (not 502). Minor semantics.

voice_preview.py preview(): if OpenAITextToSpeech fails (e.g. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing/expired), the exception bubbles as 500 with no graceful message. Consider try/except -> HTTPException(503, 'Audio no disponible, inténtalo de nuevo').
voice_preview.py tts(): storage.put_object failure is logged and silently swallowed — correct (cache miss next time). Good.
voice_preview.py agent_preview: ambience_id custom validation happens AFTER voice validation but BEFORE preview generation — good ordering, prevents TTS cost for unauthorized ambiences.

AmbiencePreview.jsx: creates `new Audio()` per play — no stored <audio> DOM node, which is correct for iOS silent mode (user-gesture-initiated playback). The `useEffect(() => stop, [])` cleanup is good; the `useEffect(..., [ambience, volume, voice, text])` stops playback on param change, which may surprise users mid-playback — acceptable.
AdminIntegrations.jsx ElevenLabsSettings: no inline guidance about where to find the ElevenLabs key or minimum length requirement (button disabled when key.length<20 but no label). Minor UX.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 iter-7 tests). Full regression 111/113 (2 pre-existing failures unrelated to this iteration).
success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (landing demo desktop + mobile, admin ElevenLabs panel, agent builder preview)

rca of the issue: Original bug: iOS silent-mode blocked speechSynthesis.speak() invoked via setTimeout, so users only heard the ambience keyboard loop (ambience was a real <audio> that played, speech synthesis was silently dropped by WebKit). Fix shipped: server now generates one WAV mixing TTS voice (ElevenLabs if admin key configured, else OpenAI TTS fallback) with the ambience bed; frontend plays via `new Audio().play()` inside the click handler, which is a user gesture iOS honors even in silent mode. Verified: /api/voice-preview/demo.wav returns 200 audio/wav ~>=6s with voice energy present in seconds 1-8 (not only keyboard). All review criteria pass.
